label_recipe.funding: apply only funding settlements observed between entry and exit; no future rate lookahead

decision_rule.fit: fixed Logistic win-probability plus Ridge conditional net-return baseline; scaler fit only on train_fit
decision_rule.calibration: Platt calibration and residual q10 only on later train_calibration outcomes
decision_rule.screen_selection: Base-cost model only: in fit support, calibrated probability_positive > 0.5, expected_net_increment_bps > 0, and q10_increment_bps > 0; reuse identical selected event ids for Stress
decision_rule.negative_control: within each screen block select a deterministic SHA-256-ranked random subset equal in size to model-selected entries
decision_rule.risk_adjusted_excess: mean completed-trade net bps minus 0.5 times completed-trade net-bps standard deviation
decision_rule.screen: four consecutive non-overlapping five-day Train-inner blocks; no threshold adjustment after screen outcomes are read
decision_rule.qualification: diagnostic only; cannot pass production teacher gate or establish Alpha Teacher eligibility

limitations: The project access registry can prove only known in-repository reservations; unledgered external reads cannot be excluded.
Public market data does not establish account fee tier, historical margin/leverage rules, actual fills, or account cashflows.
Kline counterfactual labels are not Nautilus native fills or proof of executable historical profit.
